verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single self-contained executable that runs without installation. Its documented `--cli` flag runs the model non-interactively against a supplied prompt, and a `--server` mode exposes an HTTP API, so it can run headlessly in scripted automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples (exit codes, scripted batch usage), independent hands-on reports of running it in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: If you add the `--cli` argument to a llamafile, you will run a CLI version of the model that answers to whatever you provide as a prompt
HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
Runs on a wide range of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD, etc.), without installation or setup.
A llamafile bundles the llamafile executable, model weights, and a set of default arguments into a single self-contained file
